title: Verify Instagram footer icon opens in a new tab with secure rel attributes
steps: Scroll to the footer social links section
Locate the Instagram icon link
Read its href, target, and rel attributes
Click the icon link, switch to the newly opened tab, and verify the destination page loads successfully (no 404 or other error page)
expected_result: Instagram link has a non-empty href, target="_blank", and rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow". Clicking it opens a new tab whose destination page loads successfully with no 404 or other error.

title: Verify Instagram footer icon has no platform-identifying accessible name (known gap)

test_data.current_aria_label: social profile - opens in a new tab

steps: Scroll to the footer social links section
Locate the Instagram icon link (href = https://www.instagram.com/skylineglass/)
Read the link's aria-label attribute
Read the alt attribute of the inside the link
Read the link's accessible name as computed by the browser (accessibility tree)
expected_result: Documents CURRENT behavior (known accessibility gap, not a defect filed): the Instagram link's aria-label is exactly " social profile - opens in a new tab" (leading space, no platform name, identical to the other 3 social icons), the inner has no alt attribute, and the computed accessible name contains no reference to "Instagram". If a platform name is later added, this case fails and must be updated.

title: Verify YouTube footer link uses http:// while other social links use https://
steps: Scroll to the footer social links section
Read the href of the Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube icon links
Note the protocol (scheme) of each href
Click the YouTube icon link and switch to the newly opened tab
Observe the final URL in the new tab and any security/insecure-connection warning
expected_result: Documents CURRENT behavior: Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook hrefs start with "https://"; the YouTube href starts with "http://" (protocol inconsistency). Opening the YouTube link ends on an https:// URL (server redirect) with no browser insecure-connection warning. Any other outcome (warning page, no redirect, load failure) is a deviation to report.
